reuse.why: The rule change is made inside the existing getRangeAmount/getExpectedAmount helpers that all schedule consumers already call, and keeps using getApproxNumberThreshold.

duplication.why: No logic is duplicated; the change simplifies the two helper bodies to Math.min and amount - threshold.

placement.why: The worst-case rule stays in shared/schedules.ts where the tree defines it, with tests beside it.

scope.why: Focused on the helpers, their tests and a release note, though it leaves the now-stale 'end furthest from zero' comment in forecast-schedules.ts untouched.

maintainability.why: A one-line definition change in the single shared helper with updated comments and tests is easy to own.
